Marker codes are globally distinct; the center code is globally distinct from every marker; noncentral role pads have different constant weight. Two complete event halos therefore cannot overlap.

stages.ready_to_herald: The center recognizes the complete prepared halo and replaces the retained dark neutral pair by the addressed dark/event herald. Physical pointer records remain in the halo.
stages.dark_herald: Advance the two local pointer cycles and restore the dark herald.
stages.bright_herald: On the following tick, role sites read the retained center herald and create one charged source packet plus two neutral gravity packets.
stages.recovery: Reverse the source/packet creation, advance the pointer cycles, and restore the dark herald.
stages.permutation: READY, HERALD, and RECOVERY form one exact finite staged permutation on the prepared apparatus component.
